event: Vermont Green FC defeated Flint City Bucks 2-1 in the 2026 USL League Two Final to claim back-to-back national championships, completing an undefeated season (18W-1D-0L) and extending their unbeaten run to 42 matches.

Flint City Bucks lost 2-1 to Vermont Green FC in the USL League Two Final at Atwood Stadium, finishing as runners-up after a deep playoff run that included wins over FC Buffalo, Steel City FC, Peoria City, and Ventura County Fusion.

Vermont Green FC set single-season club records in goals scored (85) and assists (11 by Diego Rosas), with Jeremy Francou winning the golden boot at 18 goals — signaling sustained roster quality likely to attract upward transfer interest.
Vermont Green FC drew hundreds of traveling supporters to Atwood Stadium in Flint for the national final, demonstrating a growing away fan base for a Tier 4 club.
Laredo Heat SC lost 7-1 to Vermont Green FC in the USL League Two national semifinal, conceding five second-half goals after trailing 2-1 at halftime.
Deportivo Rose City won the UPSL West Region Final 2-1 over Next Level Soccer, earning the club's first-ever berth at the UPSL Spring National Finals in Los Angeles (August 7-9).
Central Kansas United won the UPSL Central Region Final 2-1 over West Texas Rush, securing the club's first-ever appearance at the UPSL Spring National Finals.
NY Renegades FC defeated Detroit City FC II 3-1 to claim the UPSL East Region title and return to the National Finals in Los Angeles for the second consecutive season.
Miami United FC claimed the UPSL Southeast Region Championship in a penalty shootout after a 1-1 draw, returning to the UPSL National Finals for the second straight season.

Brooklyn FC signed forward Juan Carlos Obregón Jr. from USL League One's Westchester SC, where he won the Golden Boot with 17 goals in 29 appearances — a cross-tier move strengthening their inaugural Championship roster.
Westchester SC lost Golden Boot winner Juan Carlos Obregón Jr. (17 goals, USL League One Player of the Year) to USL Championship's Brooklyn FC via cross-tier transfer.
Athletic Club Boise led USL League One in total attendance through early June 2026 with 43,248 cumulative fans, including a season-high of 7,227 for the home match against Chattanooga Red Wolves SC.
Corpus Christi FC sits on a 10-game winless streak to open the 2026 USL League One season — the longest active winless run in the league.
Fort Wayne FC recorded a 7-game unbeaten run through at least May 30, 2026 — the longest active unbeaten streak in USL League One.

Sacramento Republic FC and Wilton Rancheria announced Republic Stadium at The Railyards will forgo original phased expansion plans — a significant revision to the club's stadium development strategy with direct implications for USL Premier readiness.
Louisville City FC formally announced intent to join USL Premier (D1) at launch in 2028, becoming the first Championship club to publicly commit to the new top tier.
Pittsburgh Riverhounds SC are in the process of building a new stadium with the stated intent to meet USL Premier Division One capacity requirements ahead of the 2028 launch.
Detroit City FC initiated a stadium project with the stated intent to meet USL Premier Division One capacity requirements ahead of the 2028 launch.
Miami FC initiated a stadium project with the stated intent to meet USL Premier Division One capacity requirements ahead of the 2028 launch.
